title: Describe an Event Preparation

source.rights: 原创 AI 辅助虚构教学材料；尚待独立教学与发音审核。

instructions: Prepare briefly and record your own response of 120–160 words. The sample is shorter than the 90–120 second target. Add relevant details and allow natural pauses while staying within 120–160 words.
prompt: Speak for about 90–120 seconds, using 120–160 words. Describe a fictional community concert, who will perform, what is being prepared, and what needs to be checked. Use at least six lesson words.
reference: I would like to help prepare a small concert at a community venue. The audience could sit in a room with thirty chairs, and the invitation would explain the time and admission. A singer and a band might play one song, followed by a guest with a violin. Before the rehearsal, the microphone must be checked and each instrument needs a safe place. The stage is being cleaned, so the musicians could practice in a side room first. My friend could make a banner to decorate the entrance, and I could announce the order of the programme. We would invite neighbors to sign up rather than expecting a large crowd. After the music, people could applaud and speak with the performers. We would put the chairs back before leaving.
